en.sayed-ali-raza: When the Prophet - the peace and blessing of Allāh be upon him and his descendants - died his head was on my chest,
and his (last) breath blew over my palms and I passed it over my face.

I performed his (funeral) ablution, may Allāh bless him and his descendants, and the angels helped me. The house and the courtyard were full of them. One party of them was descending and the other was ascending.
My ears continually caught their humming voice, as they invoked Allāh’s blessing on him, till we buried him in his grave.
